ABOUT THIS STUDY

One place, two costs.

Routes connect A → walk → pickup → e-bike → return → walk → B within Central Park and its 1 km buffer.

Terrain and routes

Actual OSM ways are used. Inside the park, Drives, cycleways and explicitly bicycle-permitted paths support riding; foot-only paths remain walk-only. One-way and access restrictions apply.

Real terrain heights: Mapzen Terrarium DEM, sampled every 30 m along roads. Grade g = elevation change / horizontal distance. Weight = max(1, 18 × |g|). Up to 1:18 (5.56%) the weight is 1; at 1:9 it is 2. Route selection and moving time use this weight, for walking and riding in either direction. The map colors roads green to brown with increasing elevation.

DEM resolution limits short-slope accuracy and may not represent bridge decks, tunnels or stairs. This is terrain-aware planning, not a surveyed accessibility assessment. Energy uses MET × 3.5 × kg / 200 × slope-adjusted minutes. This is a model rather than a measured exercise response.

Fares and data

Rental minutes round up once. Taxes and discounts are excluded; long-ride billing rules remain unverified. Terrain, OSM roads, NYC Parks and GBFS are loaded in the browser. Live routing stops if terrain cannot load; examples and older snapshots explicitly disclose missing elevations.

Check local signs and closures. Station availability, batteries and arrival docks are not guaranteed.
